title: Ink
description: Another Paper Plugin wich features some Enchantments, Discord-RCP, Grave System and Villager-Shop
body:
# Ink

**In development & it's a project I'm doing for “fun” (my own Minecraft server)**\
**I do not actively maintain this project. Feel free to fork, modify, and use it as you wish under the following condition:**
> You must clearly credit me (Cedrik B. or GitHub username) and provide a link to the Projects GitHub repository in a visible place (e.g., in your README or project description).
## About the Plugin
### **Discord RCP**
self-explanatory: Sends messages from Minecraft to Discord and vice versa

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>
  
- **Shop:** Every trade in Villager Profession's and some extra's
- **Sit:** _I do not know why I implemented it_
- **Home:** Simple Teleport system, has a Cooldown of 30 minutes [Currently Unchangeable]
  
</details>


<details>
<summary>Enchantment's</summary>

- **Oracle:** Give's an XP boost to killing or mining
- **Telekinesis:** Items dropped (by mining or killing) are directly put into your inventory.
- **Tree Chopper:** Falls down the whole Tree
- **Vein:** Mines one whole Ore-Vein

</details>


<details>
<summary>Anti-Mob-Griefing</summary>

- **Creeper explosions:** _Disables block damage by Creeper Explosions_
- **Ghast explosions:** _Fire charges which are shot by a Ghast_
- **Enderman's:** _Block Pickup by Enderman_

</details>



### Widely Configurable
Look at the default Configuration it's located in: [**plugins/Ink/config.yml**](https://github.com/CiklesCedrik/Ink/blob/master/src/main/resources/config.yml)

### Translation
- English en_US\
- Deutsch de_DE
